auth.notAdmin: This Telegram account is not an admin.

errors.invalidState: This can't be done any more: the order or delivery has moved on.

catalog.name: Name

catalog.noVariants: No variants yet. A product needs at least one to be sold.
catalog.photosHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. The first photo is the one shoppers see in the list.
catalog.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. lip-care.
catalog.attributesHint: Attributes are what variants differ by, such as shade or volume. Each belongs to one category.
catalog.attributeKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _, e.g. shade.

orders.cannotCancel: The courier has already picked this order up, so it can no longer be cancelled.
orders.cancelMessage: The customer gets {{total}} back in full and the items return to stock. This can't be undone.

orders.cancelMessageUnpaid: No money was taken for this order, so there is nothing to refund. The items return to stock. This can't be undone.

couriers.name: First name
couriers.nameHint: Customers see this name on their order.
couriers.deactivateMessage: They lose access to the courier section at once. Their current deliveries stay with them until you take them off.
couriers.releaseMessage: The order goes back to the pool for any courier to take.
couriers.releaseShippedMessage: The courier has already picked this order up. Do this only if they can't finish, for example they're unreachable. The order goes back to the pool.
couriers.nobodyOnMap: No courier is sharing a position right now.

admins.name: Name
admins.rolesHint: Owner: everything. Catalog manager: products, categories, photos. Dispatcher: orders, couriers, deliveries.
admins.deactivateMessage: They lose access to the admin panel at once.
admins.resetOnce: It is shown only now. Pass it on privately; they must change it when they sign in.

roleHints.manager: everything except admins and manual refunds
roleHints.dispatcher: orders and couriers; cancels only orders not paid yet (cash)
roleHints.accountant: revenue, orders, cancellations with refund, refunds
roleHints.viewer: sees summary, catalog, orders and couriers; changes nothing

password.mustChange: Your password was reset. Choose a new one to continue.
password.hasPassword: You can sign in with your login and password.
password.noPassword: You have no password yet. Set one to sign in from any browser and to confirm refunds and admin changes.
password.tooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters.
password.saved: Saved. Other sessions of yours have been signed out.
